# Simulate the reporter's app: AppConfig without default_auto_field override,

        class Meta:
            app_label = 'django.contrib.contenttypes'

    class Child(Base):
        class Meta:
            app_label = 'django.contrib.contenttypes'

    print('Base pk:', Base._meta.pk, 'auto_created:', Base._meta.pk.auto_created)
    print('Child pk:', Child._meta.pk, 'auto_created:', Child._meta.pk.auto_created)
    print('Child pk is Base pk field object?', Child._meta.pk is Base._meta.pk)
    print('Child local pk?', Child._meta.pk in Child._meta.local_fields)
    for m in (Base, Child):
        print(m._meta.label, [str(e) for e in m.check()])
